title: MC Brawls
description: Minecraft minigames with friends - compete and win!
body:
**MC Brawls** is a Minecraft minigames server with a focus on fun, fast games and a competitive edge. Jump in solo or party up!

![brawls hub](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/mImGsti0/images/be918e8ae456205e40f7e02b18d38eee1ffaba0b_350.webp)

**One Shot** is simple: you've got an Infinity Bow, a Riptide Trident, and a lobby full of players to eliminate. Grab powerups like Multishot, Wind Charges, and Invisibility. Get as many kills as you can before the clock hits zero.

![one shot](https://cdn.mcbrawls.net/img/one-shot-range-water-update.png)
![one shot 2](https://cdn.mcbrawls.net/img/stormscraper-promo.png)

**Rise** is all about avoiding the floor. Powder rains down constantly and one wrong step eliminates you.  
**Rise: Capture** takes that same chaos and adds a team objective, with players scrapping over a centre monument using Knockback Sticks.

![rise arena](https://cdn.mcbrawls.net/img/rise-stage-promo-2.png)

**Spleef and Rocket Spleef** are two similar games. Spleef is a classic - dig the floor out from under your opponents and don't fall yourself. Rocket Spleef does the same thing but hands everyone an Elytra and a Rocket Launcher, with random mutators like Meteor Strike and Blindfold shaking things up.

We also host **Dodgebolt** — two teams, one-shot arrows, last team standing.

Every game has its own **Mastery** system — play, hit objectives, and earn XP and Coins as you go.  
Climb the **leaderboards** to see how you stack up.  
Grab **Titles** to show off on your profile

**Join at `play.mcbrawls.net`**
